name: Garni Gruber
beschreibung: The Garni Gruber is situated in a quiet location in Tirol, nestled in the landscape of the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The rooms of the house are comfortably furnished and some have balconies with mountain views. In the morning, guests fuel up at the breakfast buffet before exploring the surroundings. In summer, the region's hiking trails and mountain railways invite guests to enjoy activities in nature. In winter, the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental is easily reachable via the ski buses. The garden and the sauna area of the house offer relaxation. The Garni Gruber thus offers a family-friendly base for stays in the Tiroler Alpen.
